datasets.name: rebid_rates

datasets.name: eval_runs

datasets.name: eval_latest
queryLines: SELECT recall5_strict, recall5_lenient, citation_validity, claim_support, refusal_accuracy, claims_removed_mechanical + claims_removed_verifier AS claims_removed FROM procurement.ops.kpi_eval_runs ORDER BY run_ts DESC LIMIT 1

datasets.name: eval_trend
queryLines: SELECT run_ts, 'strict (gold passage)' AS measure, recall5_strict AS recall_at_5 FROM procurement.ops.kpi_eval_runs UNION ALL SELECT run_ts, 'lenient (any passage with the answer)', recall5_lenient FROM procurement.ops.kpi_eval_runs WHERE recall5_lenient IS NOT NULL

datasets.name: usage_daily
queryLines: SELECT * FROM procurement.ops.kpi_usage_daily ORDER BY day DESC

datasets.name: usage_totals
queryLines: SELECT (SELECT coalesce(sum(requests), 0) FROM procurement.ops.kpi_usage_daily) AS requests, (SELECT coalesce(sum(llm_calls), 0) FROM procurement.ops.kpi_usage_daily) AS llm_calls, (SELECT coalesce(sum(thumbs_up), 0) FROM procurement.ops.kpi_feedback_daily) AS thumbs_up, (SELECT coalesce(sum(thumbs_down), 0) FROM procurement.ops.kpi_feedback_daily) AS thumbs_down

datasets.name: feedback_daily
queryLines: SELECT * FROM procurement.ops.kpi_feedback_daily ORDER BY day DESC

lines: Frozen evaluation set, **test half only** (the refusal threshold is calibrated on the other half). Strict recall counts only the gold passage; lenient recall counts any retrieved passage an LLM judge finds contains the answer. Claims removed = mechanical citation checks + claim-support verifier.
**These are developer test requests, not users.** The app has not been piloted; usage and feedback numbers are meaningful only after a pilot starts. LLM calls = answer + claim verifier per request.
